title: Curtis Mosby and Ivie Anderson
summary: Mosby was a drummer turned impresario and owner; Ivie Anderson started as an ingenue there.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Was Curtis Moseby a musician or just -- I know he owned a club and -- did he lead a band?
He was originally the drummer. In fact, he drummed several times when he'd come over -- you know -- come up and play a few sets and things like that.

Then he became the impresario and owner, and he did the office work. He stayed in there. And quite a few stars and quite a few personalities were hatched out of those aggregations. Mostly vocal and or acting wise.
Do you remember any of the --
Did she play in the Apex Club?

Yeah, she was ingenue. She could dance you know -- do a sort of an act -- sing and dance. And let's see, who else. Oh, any number of artists. Everybody that came out here. And we used to have big -- big groups of artists that came to the clubs. And finally some shows -- stage shows came to Los Angeles from the East --
